    - text: "This example shows how one can use the FFMPEG integration / in ossia score to send & receive arbitrary streams. / First, start an UDP stream from the command line: / ffmpeg -re -f lavfi -i testsrc=size=1280x720:rate=30 -re -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=1000:sample_rate=44100 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 96k -f mpegts udp://127.0.0.1:5000 / score will receive it through two shaders: / 1) Hyperspace will display it in the background. / 2) Color controls will apply another effect to the source and stream it to another ffmpeg instance at port 5001: / you can listen with / ffplay udp://127.0.0.1:5001 / It is also possible to use gstreamer but a suitable gstreamer build / must be available on your machine."
